title.zh: 前豆包PC端负责人齐俊元创办的Today AI累计融资超2亿美元：腾讯、蚂蚁、红杉入局，已开始自训模型
title.en: 前豆包PC端负责人齐俊元创办的Today AI累计融资超2亿美元：腾讯、蚂蚁、红杉入局，已开始自训模型

current_state.zh: Today AI, the personal AI assistant startup founded by former Doubao PC lead Qi Junyuan, disclosed over $200M in cumulative funding from Tencent, Ant Group, Sequoia China, IDG and others, and has reordered its roadmap to train its own personal-assistant model in parallel with software development, with early experimental model versions already in place.
